blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Flag bearer and young weightlifter Albert Ian Delos Santos relished the rare opportunity to carry the flag of Team Philippines in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 opening ceremony on Saturday. Moments before the parade, Delos Santos expressed his excitement to be the flag bearer with Olympic boxer Aira Villegas. “I was like, me? Out of all people? It isn’t expected and I never had imagined that I’d be a flag bearer in my life,” said Delos Santos, who was in the province when the Philippine Olympic Committee […]...
